title: Elements paintings
description: The Four Elements Paintings are now craftable in the stone cutter
body:
# **Craft The four elemental painting in the stonecutter**
This datapack adds a crafting recipe in the stonecutter for four paintings that already exist in minecraft, that players in survival gamemode do not have access to.

# **Why This Matters**
Decoration: These paintings depict four elements: Earth, water, wind, fire. These can be used to decorate your builds. They are nice and decorative paintings that many advanced builders already use when building in creative gamemode.

# **Compatibility**
Works with 1.21 and newer Compatible with most datapacks and mods

This pack is perfect if you like to incorporate unobtainable blocks in a balanced way.

Made by MeowingChip5
